{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&DIntensityVolatility", "construction": "standard deviation of R&D expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by average total assets", "rationale": "Firms with highly volatile R&D investments may be more likely to experience breakthroughs or failures, leading to divergent future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "EmployeeGrowthAccelerations", "construction": "change in 3-year employee growth rate, relative to the prior 3-year period", "rationale": "Accelerating employee growth may signal successful firm expansion or impending over-expansion, with implications for future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "IntangibleAssetObsolescence", "construction": "percentage of intangible assets that have been on the balance sheet for over 10 years, scaled by total intangible assets", "rationale": "Firms with large fractions of obsolete intangible assets may struggle to adapt to changing market conditions", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "TradeCreditorsConcentration", "construction": "Herfindahl index of trade creditor concentrations, based on accounts payable and total current liabilities", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated trade creditor bases may face higher supply chain risks and potential disruptions", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "GAAPtoTaxIncomeDispersion", "construction": "standard deviation of differences between GAAP net income and tax net income over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with large dispersions between GAAP and tax accounting results may be engaging in aggressive tax or accounting practices, with uncertain implications for future returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "BoardMemberBusyiness", "construction": "average number of other public company board seats held by each firm's board members", "rationale": "Firms with busy, over-committed board members may suffer from inadequate oversight and guidance", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "DividendPayoutSmoothing", "construction": "standard deviation of dividend payout ratios over the past 10 years", "rationale": "Firms that smooth dividend payouts may be prioritizing shareholder returns over investment opportunities, with implications for future growth", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "InstitutionalInvestorHerding", "construction": "percentage of institutional investor holdings that are also held by the top 5 institutional investors in the stock", "rationale": "Firms with high levels of institutional herding may be more susceptible to future price movements driven by coordinated investor actions", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "CapitalExpenditureReversals", "construction": "frequency of years with declining capital expenditures, over the past 10 years", "rationale": "Firms that frequently reverse or reduce capital expenditures may be experiencing changing business conditions or poor investment decisions", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "OptionMarketImpliedSkewness", "construction": "implied skewness of firm-level stock option prices, estimated using a parametric model", "rationale": "Fims with high implied skewness in option markets may be perceived as having greater potential for extreme returns, either positive or negative", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
